entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: count_values native-histogram input is %T with %s sample kind
entries.rationale: lowerCountValues and lowerHistogramNativeRoot call this helper only after countValuesOverExpHistogramValue admits the operand and lowerExpHistogramValuedShape successfully lowers that same operand. Every matched histogram lowerer publishes SampleKindHistogram, so this guard can fire only if an internal lowering postcondition is broken.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: count_values requires a string-literal label name as the first arg
entries.rationale: the PromQL typechecker admits only a string literal as count_values' parameter; this holds identically regardless of which caller reaches this lowerer — lowerRoot / lowerHistogramNativeSubqueryInner via lowerHistogramNativeRoot, or lowerAggregate's COUNT_VALUES dispatch via lowerCountValues (cerberus issue #2568) — since the typechecker runs during parsing, before any lowering entry point is reached.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: count_values requires a non-empty label name
